chunks: I advise you to fear Allah,

O my child, and to adhere to His commands, and to fill your heart with His remembrance, and to hold fast to His rope; and what connection is more reliable than the connection between you and Allah if you take hold of it?

key_terms.بِحَبْلِهِ: To His rope (metaphor for divine connection)

ai.seo_question: What are the key spiritual instructions Imam Ali gave to his son Hasan in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Delivered during the pivotal to Hasan ibn Ali as he prepared for leadership following the Treaty of Hasan, this advice underscores the spiritual foundation of political authority in Shia thought. Imam Ali (peace be upon him) prioritizes internal spiritual fortification—specifically the 'occupation of the heart' with divine remembrance—over external worldly ties, framing Taqwa as the ultimate anchor. This instruction reflects the transition from the era of battle to governance, emphasizing that steadfastness in divine covenant is the most secure means of navigating societal complexities.
